reasons.realCost: At the sell-grid sizes, Systeme.io's real bill matches its sticker price exactly ($17, $47 or $97), since every plan charges 0% of sales, though the Free plan's USD 10,000 lifetime-sales cap pushes a solo seller onto a paid plan within a few months.
reasons.pricingHonesty: Plan prices and limits are published on the pricing page, but the page's own FAQ contradicts its comparison table on funnel, student and automation-rule limits.
reasons.smallTeamFit: Systeme.io bundles funnels, email, courses and a store into one no-code account a solo owner can set up without a developer, with unlimited assistant accounts included on every plan.
reasons.doesTheJob: One subscription replaces separate funnel, email, course and affiliate-management tools, though physical-product selling is capped at 50, 100 or 250 variants on the lower plans.
reasons.freedomToLeave: Every paid plan can be billed monthly with no annual lock-in, but subscriptions are non-refundable and downgrading is not self-serve, requiring a support ticket and a custom order form.
reasons.trackRecord: Systeme.io launched in 2018, a shorter public history than the older platforms in this group.

basis: Systeme.io's flat, 0%-transaction-fee pricing and generous free tier make it the best-value all-in-one for a solo course or funnel seller, though its shorter history and manual downgrade process are worth weighing against more established platforms.
method: Two separate AI passes (two runs of Anthropic's Claude over the same evidence, neither seeing the other's score) scored six factors (1–5) and an overall; published overall is the lower of the two overall scores, because this tool runs an affiliate program we have joined or may join. Pass scores: 4.3 and 3.9.
